movement_profile.formation_and_space: The lion effigy is carried by four or two men using bamboo rods in a procession through the village.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: The performance involves carrying the lion high, sometimes involving acrobatics.
movement_profile.partnering: The carriers must work in unison to balance and move the lion-shaped palanquin while carrying a child.

signature_moves.description: Supporting a lion-shaped effigy on a palanquin while performing dance movements.
signature_moves.name: Lion carrying

music_profile.sound_description: A traditional ensemble featuring the percussive drive of the kendang and gong, melodic lines from the suling bamboo flute, and the bright, piercing tone of the trumpet.

basic_steps: Carrying the palanquin in a group of two or four
Coordinating movement with the rhythm of the kendang and gong
Performing acrobatic movements while supporting the effigy
teaching.formation: The lion effigy is carried by two or four men, with the child rider positioned on top.
